title: A finite radicial local model extends to an affine neighbourhood
statement: Let S be a scheme, s a point, and g:Z→Spec(O_S,s) a finitely presented finite surjective universally injective morphism. There is an affine open U containing s and a finitely presented finite surjective universally injective V→U whose pullback to the local stalk is the specified g; the base projection composes to the canonical local-stalk map to S. proof.text: Use the affine-neighbourhood stalk limit. Apply finite radicial model descent. Identify the selected stage with its open subscheme U. Transport the model and cartesian square along the isomorphisms of the stalk and stage; the projection equation is unchanged. All four morphism properties are invariant under those isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_radicial_neighbourhood_model
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Z ⟶ Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [IsFinite g] [Surjective g]
    [UniversallyInjective g] :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : s ∈ U) (_ : IsAffineOpen U)
      (V : Scheme.{u}) (p : V ⟶ U.toScheme)
      (a : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ U.toScheme),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation p ∧ IsFinite p ∧ Surjective p ∧
      UniversallyInjective p ∧ a ≫ U.ι = S.fromSpecStalk s ∧
      ∃ h : Z ⟶ V, IsPullback h g p a
